## Tooling situation first

I have no literature-search tool in this session. The only server connected is **Galaxy** (tool/workflow search and execution — I confirmed this by searching its catalogue). There is no PubMed, Europe PMC, bioRxiv, or web access available to me, so **I cannot run a live literature query**, and I won't pretend to have.

What follows is therefore **from my own knowledge**, with a knowledge cutoff of **May 2026** — so anything published in roughly the last six months is invisible to me. I've flagged the citations I'm confident of versus those where I'm unsure of the exact venue/date. Treat DOIs and volume numbers as needing verification.

---

## AlphaFold core methods

- **Jumper et al. (2021), "Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold," *Nature* 596:583–589**, doi:10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2. The original. *(High confidence.)*
- **Evans et al., AlphaFold-Multimer**, bioRxiv 2021.10.04.463034 — the complex-prediction extension; still the baseline many antibody papers compare against. *(High confidence.)*
- **Abramson et al. (2024), "Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3," *Nature* 630:493–500**, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07487-6. Diffusion-based, handles ligands/nucleic acids/ions. Code released November 2024 under a non-commercial licence, weights on request. *(High confidence.)*
- **AlphaFold Protein Structure Database** — Varadi et al., *NAR* 2022 with a 2024 update; ~214M predicted structures. *(High confidence on existence; less so on the exact update year.)*
- **Open AF3-class reimplementations**, all 2024–2025: **Boltz-1** (Wohlwend et al., bioRxiv, Nov 2024) and **Boltz-2** (2025, adds binding-affinity prediction), **Chai-1** (Chai Discovery, Sept 2024), **Protenix** (ByteDance, 2025), **OpenFold3**. These matter practically because AF3's licence blocks commercial antibody work. *(Confident these exist; exact release months approximate.)*

## Antibody-specific structure prediction

- **IgFold** — Ruffolo, Chu, Mahajan & Gray, "Fast, accurate antibody structure prediction from deep learning on massive set of natural antibodies," ***Nature Communications* 14:2389 (2023)**. Language-model-based, seconds per Fv. *(High confidence.)*
- **ImmuneBuilder / ABodyBuilder2** — Abanades et al., ***Communications Biology* 6:575 (2023)**; bundles ABodyBuilder2, NanoBodyBuilder2, TCRBuilder2. Predecessor: **ABlooper** (*Bioinformatics*, 2022) for CDR loops. *(High confidence.)*
- **ABodyBuilder3** — Kenlay et al., ***Bioinformatics* (2024)** — improved/scalable successor with better pLDDT calibration. *(Moderate-high confidence.)*
- **DeepAb** — Ruffolo et al., ***Patterns* (2022)**. *(High confidence.)*
- **tFold-Ab / tFold-Ag** (Tencent, bioRxiv 2024) — antibody–antigen complex modelling and design. *(Moderate confidence.)*

**The consistent finding across these:** unbound antibody Fv frameworks are essentially solved (sub-Å framework RMSD); **CDR-H3 remains the error hotspot**, typically 2–3 Å RMSD, and specialised antibody models beat generic AlphaFold2 on H3 while being orders of magnitude faster.

## The hard part: antibody–antigen complexes

This is where the interesting recent literature sits.

- **Yin & Pierce (2024), "Evaluation of AlphaFold antibody–antigen modeling with implications for improving predictive accuracy," *Protein Science* 33:e4865.** Key number: AlphaFold2.3-Multimer succeeds on roughly **30%** of antibody–antigen targets — far below its performance on general protein complexes. Also reports that confidence metrics (ipTM) are usefully discriminative even when accuracy is low. *(High confidence in the finding; the ~30% figure is from memory and worth re-checking.)*
- **Yin, Ndungu & Pierce (2022), *Protein Science* 31:e4379** — earlier benchmark establishing that Ab–Ag is the weak class. *(High confidence.)*
- **Hitawala & Gray, "What has AlphaFold3 learned about antibody and nanobody docking, and what remains unsolved?"** — bioRxiv 2024 (I believe 2024.09.21.614257), subsequently published in 2025. Finding: AF3 improves over AF2-Multimer on Ab–Ag but is still well short of its performance on other interface types, and it appears partly to recall training-set epitopes rather than generalise. *(Moderate confidence on the identifier; confident on the paper's existence and conclusion.)*
- **CASP16 (results Dec 2024)** — AF3-class diffusion methods dominated, with antibody–antigen interfaces again among the poorest-scoring categories. *(Confident on the trend, not on per-target numbers.)*
- **Massive-sampling approaches** — AFsample, MassiveFold (2024) — brute-force seed/recycle sampling plus ranking measurably raises Ab–Ag success rate. *(Moderate confidence.)*

## Adjacent: antibody *design*, not just prediction

- **Bennett et al., "Atomically accurate de novo design of single-domain antibodies" / RFantibody** — bioRxiv 2024, with journal publication in 2025. RFdiffusion fine-tuned to design VHH and scFv binders to specified epitopes, experimentally validated with cryo-EM. *(Confident on existence; unsure of final journal.)*
- **AlphaProteo** (DeepMind, 2024) — general protein binder design, reported 3–300× affinity improvements over prior methods. *(Moderate confidence.)*
- **IgDesign** (Absci, 2024) — inverse-folding-based CDR design with wet-lab binding validation. *(Moderate confidence.)*
- **AntiFold** — antibody-specific inverse folding (ESM-IF fine-tune), 2024. *(Moderate confidence.)*

---

## If you want to actually run predictions

The connected Galaxy instance has ColabFold available — I verified these tool IDs exist in its catalogue:

- `toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/iuc/colabfold_msa/colabfold_msa/1.5.5+galaxy1` — "Generate MSAs for the Alphafold step of Colabfold"
- `toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/iuc/colabfold_alphafold/colabfold_alphafold/1.5.5+galaxy1` — "Predict protein structures with Colabfold"

Both sit in the Proteomics panel section. A search for `antibody` returned **0 tools** — no IgFold/ABodyBuilder/ANARCI wrapper on this instance. Say the word and I'll set up a history and run a ColabFold job on an Fv sequence.

## ANSWER

I have **no literature-search tool** in this session (only Galaxy), so this is from my own knowledge, cutoff May 2026 — unverified and likely missing the last ~6 months.

**AlphaFold methods:** Jumper et al. *Nature* 596:583 (2021); AlphaFold-Multimer (bioRxiv 2021.10.04.463034); **Abramson et al., AlphaFold 3, *Nature* 630:493 (2024)**, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07487-6; open AF3-class models Boltz-1/-2, Chai-1, Protenix, OpenFold3 (2024–25).

**Antibody structure prediction:** IgFold (*Nat Commun* 14:2389, 2023); ImmuneBuilder/ABodyBuilder2 (*Commun Biol* 6:575, 2023); ABodyBuilder3 (*Bioinformatics*, 2024); DeepAb (*Patterns*, 2022). Fv frameworks are solved; **CDR-H3 (~2–3 Å) is the remaining error source.**

**Antibody–antigen complexes — the open problem:** Yin & Pierce, *Protein Science* 33:e4865 (2024) — AF2.3-Multimer succeeds on only ~30% of Ab–Ag targets; Hitawala & Gray (bioRxiv 2024, pub. 2025) — AF3 improves but does not solve it, with signs of epitope memorisation; CASP16 confirmed Ab–Ag as a worst-performing interface class.

**Design side:** RFantibody/Bennett et al. (2024–25), AlphaProteo (2024), IgDesign (2024), AntiFold (2024).

Available here to run: Galaxy ColabFold (`colabfold_msa`, `colabfold_alphafold`, v1.5.5+galaxy1). No antibody-specific tools on this instance (0 hits for "antibody").
